description_en: Stylizes a human portrait into a sketch
description_zh: 本文介绍添加人脸人体（facebody）类目下的人像素描风格化GenerateHumanSketchStyle的语法及示例
name: GenerateHumanSketchStyle

parameters.help_en:
The image URL. Use an OSS URL in the China (Shanghai) region. For files stored locally or in OSS buckets outside the China (Shanghai) region, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html.
Image format requirements:

Image format: JPG, JPEG, or PNG.
Image size: less than 10 MB.
Image resolution: greater than 100 × 100 pixels and less than 2,000 × 2,000 pixels. The longest side must be less than or equal to 1,999 pixels. The face must occupy at least 60 × 60 pixels.
Image quality: A clear front-facing photo with a single face is supported. The face orientation must be within 45 degrees up, down, left, or right.
The URL cannot contain Chinese characters.
Image content: If the image resolution exceeds the maximum limit, scale and resize the image first. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/44688.html
parameters.help_zh:
图像URL地址。推荐使用上海地域的OSS链接，对于文件在本地或者非上海地域OSS链接的情况，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html。
图片格式要求：

图像格式：JPG、JPEG、PNG。
图像大小：小于10 MB。
图像分辨率：大于100×100像素，小于2000×2000像素，最长边小于等于1999像素；人脸占比不低于60×60像素。
图像质量：支持有单人人脸的清晰正面照，人脸朝向在上下左右45度以内。
URL地址中不能包含中文字符。
图像内容：当图像分辨率超过最大限制时，请先将图片进行缩放，调整图片大小，具体请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/44688.html
parameters.name: image_url

parameters.help_en:
The return format of the image. Valid values:

head: headshot (default)
full: full-body photo

Use headshots for better processing results
parameters.help_zh:
图像返回形式。取值如下：

head：大头照（默认）
full：全身照

推荐使用大头照，处理效果更佳
parameters.name: return_type

ImageURL.description_en:
The URL of the returned image.
The URL is a temporary URL and is valid for 30 minutes. It becomes inaccessible after it expires
ImageURL.description_zh:
返回图片URL地址。
该URL地址为临时地址，有效期为30分钟，过期后将无法访问
